Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the postretirement employment of retirees by school districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to postretirement employment of retirees by schooldistricts; adding a new section to chapter 28A.400 RCW; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.400RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a school district hires a retiree as defined in RCW 41.32.010,41.34.020, 41.35.010, or 41.40.010 for any postretirement employmentunder RCW 41.32.570 in two consecutive school years, the district maynot hire the retiree for any further postretirement employment unlessthe superintendent of public instruction determines that otherqualified persons are not currently available in the local labor marketarea to fill the position. Before making this determination, thesuperintendent of public instruction must review at least the resumesand any other related materials submitted by all applicants for theposition. Notwithstanding the review required by the superintendent ofpublic instruction, the resumes and other related materials areconfidential and are not open to public inspection.
Section 1 of this act applies to schoolyears that begin after August 1, 2003.
